categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the R&D, design, production, and sales of high-precision, high-density, complex-shaped, and aesthetically refined precision components. Its main product lines include Metal Injection Molding (MIM) products, other metal process products and plastic products, and mold tooling and equipment. The company serves primarily the consumer electronics sector, including foldable smartphones, tablets, laptops, smart pens, wearable devices, drones, and other smart devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as Metal Injection Molding (MIM), high-precision wire cutting, CNC machining, laser processing, high-speed continuous stamping, and precision injection molding. It actively invests in new materials like titanium alloys and emerging technologies such as 3D printing to enhance product performance and expand its manufacturing capabilities. The company also emphasizes automation and digitalization in production to improve efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known domestic and international consumer electronics brands and their EMS manufacturers, such as Apple, Honor, Amazon, and Anker Innovations. The products are mainly used in new consumer electronics, including foldable smartphones, tablets, laptops, smart wearable devices, drones, and other smart terminal devices. The company is expanding its customer base and product lines to diversify market exposure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing facilities in Shenzhen, Hunan (Changsha), and overseas in Vietnam. It serves both domestic and international markets, benefiting from China's dual circulation economic strategy. The company also has subsidiaries and business operations in Hong Kong, the United States, and Vietnam, with financial reporting in RMB and USD.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of precision metal and plastic components for downstream consumer electronics manufacturers. It acts as a key R&D and manufacturing supplier to major brand owners and EMS providers, integrating closely with their product development and production processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on innovation-driven development, emphasizing new materials application (e.g., titanium alloys), 3D printing technology, and AI-driven industry transformation. It invests heavily in R&D to develop differentiated technical solutions and expand its product portfolio. The company is also advancing capacity expansion projects in Changsha and Vietnam to support growth and market diversification, while promoting digitalization and intelligent manufacturing to enhance operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized precision components to EMS manufacturers designated by brand owners. The company engages early in product design and development phases with customers, enabling collaborative product development and volume production. Revenue streams include sales of MIM products, other metal and plastic components, and mold tooling and equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the precision metal components manufacturing industry, recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It competes with other advanced precision component manufacturers in China and globally, leveraging its comprehensive technology platform, diversified manufacturing capabilities, and strong customer relationships to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 814 million, representing a 44.93% year-over-year increase, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising by 26.99%. The company crossed the USD 100 million revenue threshold, marking a significant scale milestone. It maintains strong cash flow generation and continues to invest about 12% of revenue in R&D, supporting sustained growth and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its comprehensive and innovative precision component manufacturing capabilities, including MIM and multiple complementary metal and plastic processing technologies. It offers highly customized, high-quality products with reliable delivery and competitive pricing. Its early involvement in customer product development and continuous innovation in materials and processes provide customers with differentiated technical solutions, enhancing collaboration stickiness and market share.
